title: FAA issues first eVTOL passenger-carrying flight authorization
summary: Piloted Beta Technologies air taxi flights may carry potential buyers to plan how the air taxi might fit into their business, the company's CEO said.

title: With critical PHP vulnerabilities identified, cities urged to shore up systems
summary: The threat to large and medium-sized local governments is categorized as high, and smaller local governments face a medium-level threat, the Multi-State Information Sharing and Analysis Center said.

title: Heat pumps are still expensive. Cities can help.
summary: Cities can use collective purchasing, streamlined permitting and targeted assistance to give residents access to efficient heating and cooling, Elephant Energy’s CEO writes.

title: Transit on the ballot in these 11 states
summary: Transportation advocates have high hopes for the Nov. 3 election, which will allow voters to weigh in on measures supporting road, rail, pedestrian and bike infrastructure.

title: Baltimore sues rental software platform, apartment owner over alleged junk fees
summary: The city claims that the companies steered tenants “toward fee-generating payment options by obscuring the fees associated with each payment method.”

title: After major zoning reform, Cambridge, Massachusetts, launches dashboard to track housing
summary: The city’s public-facing tracker shows nearly 250 housing projects in various stages of development.

title: $10B for PFAS removal proposed in bipartisan House bill
summary: The Protect Clean Water Act would authorize $2 billion annually to extend federal support for contaminant removal and water infrastructure.

title: LA Metro breaks ground on 12-mile bus rapid transit corridor
summary: The project will upgrade 26 bus stations along the route and connect with multiple rail lines and other bus routes.

title: Few states, cities have capacity to handle disasters without FEMA, reports find
summary: States could be expected to shoulder more disaster and recovery costs within six months, but federal reports document staffing and funding shortfalls at state and local emergency management agencies.

title: Seattle social housing hits milestone with land acquisition
summary: The Seattle Social Housing Developer Board will build around 20 mixed-income homes in the city’s Central District. It expects to own 1,000 homes by the end of next year.
